purpose: Collect actual fixed-v2 responses missing from the exposed navigation traces; finite exploratory data collection only.

environment.scene: single environment, isolated clean infinite plane, no navigation goal or obstacles
environment.reset_each_case: same default joints, zero velocities and previous action, planar origin and yaw zero; no pose writes during warmup or measurement

schedule.case_order: array order, exactly one attempt per case; no adaptation, replacement, extra settling or retry
schedule.measurement: constant requested command in the table, actual bridge command verified at every 50Hz inference; 200Hz actual state capture

capture.case_initial: save reset proof and actual stamped pose before warmup, scene origins, actual installed module, runtime clean/material/mass/dt/decimation readbacks
capture.every_physics_tick: all warmup and measurement actual x/y/yaw, body vx/vy/wz, height, quaternion and simulator clock; requested/applied/observed command evidence and case/phase/tick identities
capture.energy: save applied and requested joint torques, pre/post joint velocities, positive mechanical work at 200Hz; keep warmup and measurement J subtotals separate and independently recomputable
capture.motion_state: derive q only from consecutive actual poses using se2-completed-interval-v1; initial q uses warmup ticks 180 and 200; keep raw instantaneous body velocities separately
capture.partial_failure: stream raw actual rows during execution, save partial energy/commands/error and last completed q plus unpadded tail on termination; never fabricate missing samples

stop_rules.first_fall: save terminal substep and stop entire allocation if actual height < 0.15m or tilt > 60 degrees, matching the existing physical monitor
stop_rules.integrity_or_runtime_error: save partial evidence and stop entire allocation on missing/nonfinite/gapped state, stale command, dt mismatch, resource limit or simulator error
stop_rules.response_quality: slow motion, nonzero zero-command motion or poor tracking are descriptive outcomes, not grounds to discard a case or select a replacement
stop_rules.resource_guard: count all explicit SimulationContext.step calls before environment construction; distinguish adapter measurement ticks and native initialization whose internal steps cannot be observed; unused reserve does not authorize extra cases
stop_rules.wall_clock: one process group with durable lock; enforce total 7200s including application startup/cleanup, retain timeout/error; no automatic restart or new output root

interpretation.data_role: exposed exploratory system-identification candidates only; not heldout/final performance or calibration data
interpretation.sample_unit: one controlled case per command; ticks are correlated measurements, not independent repeated trials
interpretation.allowed_analysis: saved-state/command/timing/energy integrity, completed q capture and descriptive per-case transient/late-window tracking; no parameter estimation or policy calls
not_established: steady-state equilibrium or universal zero-command drift
90-second path residuals or old delta applicability
new alpha/delta or probabilistic safety guarantee
navigation success, G5 or NAV-043 acceptance
interpretation.next_dependency: review measured support and physical behavior before a separately bounded model-fitting/validation proposal; then reference program/J cost, independent 90-second residual protocol and affected learning/deployment gates

implementation_before_launch: Independent APPROVED registration must bind this exact proposal SHA, original output root and every limit; preserve PROPOSED and old allocations.
Implement isolated collector/once-only launcher and saved-data reviewer, reuse readonly clean_v3/plane adapter/frozen controller and no upper network imports.
Main agent performs basic synthetic timing/warmup/terminal-tail and missing-approval/conflict/resource-guard checks, then seals exact source/support hashes before any application.
Check existing processes, locks, output root, registered GPU UUID/availability and frozen package/assets; first failure is retained and stops, with no alternate host/GPU or automatic retry.
protection: Frozen whole v2, old 45-second production actor/critics, power/footprint/alpha/delta and locks unchanged; readonly reference/manuscripts and final_* isolation retained; no push.
